question: Which city hosted the 2022 Commonwealth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Birmingham**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 2022 Commonwealth Games, Officially known as XXII Commonwealth games is the 22nd edition of the Commonwealth Games.

 
• The motto of the 2022 Commonwealth Games was 'Games for Everyone'.
 
• England has hosted the Commonwealth Games for the 3rd time after London in 1934 and Manchester in 2002.
 
• Commonwealth Games 2022 is India's fifth-best in terms of the number of medals won.
 
• India's best performance was at Commonwealth Games in Delhi in 2010, where India won 101 medals. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Commonwealth Games was first held in 1930 in Hamilton, Canada. 
 
• Australia hosted the Commonwealth Games the most five times.
 
• Delhi, India hosted the Commonwealth Games in 2010.
 
• In Commonwealth Games 2022, Weightlifter Mirabai Chanu won India's First gold medal and Paddler Sharath Kamal won India's last gold medal.
